purpose: Shared live77 frame fixtures (integration plan step 2). The Python reference (framework/training/csv_v3/live77_reference.py, Layer B) and the Rust extractor (plan step 5) must both reproduce every expected vector exactly: identical NaN positions, equal float32 values.

device.note: the IPv4 address is informational: admission is by MAC only

expected_format: sparse: every input starts at 'default' (0; null = NaN), then names starting with a 'nan_prefixes' entry and names in 'nan' become NaN, then 'values' override (null = NaN); compare as float32
frame_format: t = seconds from the window start (non-decreasing, arrival order); hex = captured bytes from the Ethernet header; wire_length = original length when the capture was cut (default: captured length)
honesty: expected vectors encode the contract, including conventions still pending owner sign-off (see statuses); they are not evidence about the dataset publisher's exporter
